sql: SELECT "bridge"."architect_id" AS e, "architect"."gender" AS g, AVG((CAST(("bridge"."length_feet" - "bridge"."length_meters") AS REAL) / "bridge"."length_meters")) AS m1 FROM "bridge" JOIN "architect" ON "architect"."id" = "bridge"."architect_id"  GROUP BY "bridge"."architect_id", "architect"."gender" ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: bridge.relative difference of bridge length in feet from bridge length
why: (bridge length in feet - bridge length) / bridge length: the relative difference of two quantities in m
